title: Real shart gaplar: if, when va unless
goal_uz: Dars oxirida zero va first conditional gaplarni to‘g‘ri tuzasiz, if, when va unless ni farqlaysiz hamda shahringiz haqida va’da, ogohlantirish va umumiy faktlarni ayta olasiz.

scenes.title: Real shart gaplar
board: Lesson: Real conditionals
(Real shart gaplar)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda kelasi zamonning turli shakllarini o‘rgandik: will, going to va jadval bo‘yicha rejalar. Bugun esa kelajak bilan chambarchas bog‘liq mavzuga o‘tamiz: shart gaplar. “Agar yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz” kabi gaplarni inglizcha to‘g‘ri tuzishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida if, when va unless bilan va’da, ogohlantirish va umumiy haqiqatlarni aytib bera olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we talked about the future. Today we look at real conditionals: what happens if something happens. By the end, you will make promises, give warnings and describe real situations with confidence.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar kelajak haqida gaplashdik. Bugun real shart gaplarni ko‘ramiz: biror narsa bo‘lsa, nima bo‘ladi. Dars oxirida ishonch bilan va’da berasiz, ogohlantirasiz va real vaziyatlarni tasvirlaysiz.

scenes.title: Shart gap nima?
board: If + condition, result
If it rains, we stay at home.
(real = mumkin bo‘lgan vaziyat)

examples.t: If I have time, I'll call you.

scenes.say_native: Shart gap ikki qismdan iborat: shart va natija. “If” bilan boshlangan qism shart ergash gapi, ikkinchisi esa bosh gap. Real shart gap haqiqatan bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan vaziyatlarni bildiradi: ertaga yomg‘ir yog‘ishi mumkin, siz vaqt topishingiz mumkin. O‘zbekchada shartni fe’lga -sa qo‘shimchasi qo‘shib yasaymiz: “yog‘sa”, “bo‘lsa”. Inglizchada esa maxsus qo‘shimcha yo‘q, buning o‘rniga “if” so‘zi va to‘g‘ri zamon tanlanadi.
scenes.say: A conditional sentence has two parts: the condition and the result. A real conditional talks about situations that are possible, true, or likely. If I have time, I'll call you.
scenes.say_uz: Shart gap ikki qismdan iborat: shart va natija. Real shart gap mumkin, haqiqiy yoki ehtimoli yuqori vaziyatlar haqida gapiradi. Vaqtim bo‘lsa, sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

scenes.title: Zero conditional: umumiy haqiqat
board: If + Present Simple, Present Simple
If you heat ice, it melts.
Faktlar, qoidalar, odatlar

examples.t: If you heat ice, it melts.
If I drink coffee at night, I can't sleep.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi shakl — zero conditional, ya’ni nolinchi shart gap. Unda ikkala qismda ham Present Simple turadi. Bu shakl doim to‘g‘ri bo‘ladigan narsalarni bildiradi: ilmiy faktlar, qoidalar va shaxsiy odatlar. Bunda “if” ni “har safar” yoki “qachonki” deb tushunsa bo‘ladi. “If you heat ice, it melts” — muz qizdirilsa, har doim eriydi. Bu yerda kelajak haqida gap ketmayapti, shuning uchun “will” kerak emas.
scenes.say: If you heat ice, it melts. If I drink coffee late at night, I can't sleep. If it rains, the roads get slippery.
scenes.say_uz: Muzni qizdirsangiz, u eriydi. Kechqurun kech qahva ichsam, uxlay olmayman. Yomg‘ir yog‘sa, yo‘llar sirpanchiq bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Zero conditional: davom ettiring
board: 1) If you mix red and blue, ...
2) If I miss the bus, ...
3) If people don't drink water, ...
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni o‘zingiz davom ettiring. Natija qismida Present Simple ishlating va “will” dan foydalanmang. Birinchisida ranglar aralashtiriladi, ikkinchisida avtobusga kech qolasiz, uchinchisida odamlar suv ichmaydi. To‘xtab, javobingizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Finish the sentences. If you mix red and blue... If I miss the bus... If people don't drink water...
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni tugating. Qizil va ko‘k rangni aralashtirsangiz... Avtobusga kech qolsam... Odamlar suv ichmasa...

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) ... you get purple.
2) ... I walk to work.
3) ... they get thirsty / get ill.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: qizil va ko‘k rangni aralashtirsangiz, binafsha rang hosil bo‘ladi, “you get purple”. Ikkinchi: avtobusga kech qolsam, ishga piyoda boraman, “I walk to work”. Uchinchi: odamlar suv ichmasa, chanqaydi yoki kasal bo‘ladi, “they get thirsty”. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, bu yaxshi. Asosiysi, ikkala qismda ham Present Simple bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: If you mix red and blue, you get purple. If I miss the bus, I walk to work. If people don't drink water, they get thirsty.
scenes.say_uz: Qizil va ko‘k rangni aralashtirsangiz, binafsha rang hosil bo‘ladi. Avtobusga kech qolsam, ishga piyoda boraman. Odamlar suv ichmasa, chanqaydi.

scenes.title: First conditional: real kelajak
board: If + Present Simple, will + V1
If it rains, we'll stay at home.
Kelajakdagi real imkoniyat

examples.t: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
If you study hard, you'll pass the exam.

scenes.say_native: Endi first conditional, ya’ni birinchi shart gap. Shart qismida Present Simple, natija qismida “will” va fe’lning asosiy shakli turadi. Bu shakl kelajakda bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan aniq vaziyat haqida gapirganda kerak. “If it rains tomorrow, we’ll stay at home” — ertaga yomg‘ir yog‘ishi mumkin, agar yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz. Zero conditional bilan farqi: u har doim to‘g‘ri narsani aytadi, bu esa bitta aniq kelajak vaziyatini.
scenes.say: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home. If you study hard, you'll pass the exam. She won't be happy if you forget her birthday.
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz. Qattiq o‘qisangiz, imtihondan o‘tasiz. Tug‘ilgan kunini unutsangiz, u xursand bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Zero yoki first? Farqi
board: Zero: general truth → Present + Present
First: one future situation → Present + will
If I'm late, I call. / If I'm late tomorrow, I'll call.

examples.t: If I'm late, I always call my boss.
examples.uz: Kech qolsam, doim xo‘jayinimga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

examples.t: If I'm late tomorrow, I'll call my boss.
examples.uz: Ertaga kech qolsam, xo‘jayinimga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

scenes.say_native: Ikkala shakl o‘xshab ketadi, shuning uchun farqini aniq tushunish kerak. Odatni yoki umumiy qoidani aytsangiz, ikki Present Simple ishlating: “If I’m late, I always call my boss” — har safar shunday qilaman. Aniq bir kelajak holat haqida gapirsangiz, natijada “will” turadi: “If I’m late tomorrow, I’ll call my boss” — faqat ertangi kun haqida. O‘zbekchada ikkalasini ham “kech qolsam, qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman” deymiz, ingliz tilida esa tanlash shart.
scenes.say: If I'm late, I always call my boss. That is my habit. If I'm late tomorrow, I'll call my boss. That is one future situation.
scenes.say_uz: Kech qolsam, doim xo‘jayinimga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Bu mening odatim. Ertaga kech qolsam, xo‘jayinimga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Bu bitta kelajak vaziyat.

scenes.title: Shart qismida will bo‘lmaydi
board: ✗ If it will rain, we will stay at home.
✓ If it rains, we will stay at home.
✗ If you will come, I'll cook.  ✓ If you come, I'll cook.
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — “if” dan keyin ham “will” qo‘yish. O‘zbekchada “yog‘sa” shakli kelajakka ham, hozirga ham mos keladi, shuning uchun inglizchada ham kelajak ma’nosi borligi uchun “will” qo‘ygingiz keladi. Lekin qoida qat’iy: “if” dan keyingi shart qismida Present Simple turadi, “will” faqat natija qismiga tegishli. Shuning uchun “If it will rain” emas, “If it rains” deng.
scenes.say: Not: If it will rain. Say: If it rains, we'll stay at home. Not: If you will come. Say: If you come, I'll cook dinner.
scenes.say_uz: “If it will rain” emas. Ayting: Yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz. “If you will come” emas. Ayting: Kelsangiz, kechki ovqat pishiraman.

scenes.title: Qaysi shakl to‘g‘ri?
board: 1) If you (hurry / will hurry), you'll catch the train.
2) If he (calls / will call), I'll tell you.
3) I'll help you if you (ask / will ask).
scenes.say_native: Har bir gapda to‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang. Esda tuting: “if” dan keyin qaysi zamon turadi? Birinchi gapda poyezdga ulgurish haqida, ikkinchisida qo‘ng‘iroq haqida, uchinchisida yordam so‘rash haqida. Har bir javobni baland ovozda aytib, to‘liq gapni takrorlang.
scenes.say: Choose the correct form. If you hurry or will hurry, you'll catch the train. If he calls or will call, I'll tell you. I'll help you if you ask or will ask.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang. Shoshilsangiz, poyezdga ulgurasiz. U qo‘ng‘iroq qilsa, sizga aytaman. So‘rasangiz, yordam beraman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) hurry
2) calls
3) ask
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: “If you hurry, you’ll catch the train.” Ikkinchisi: “If he calls, I’ll tell you.” Uchinchisi: “I’ll help you if you ask.” Uchala holatda ham “if” dan keyin oddiy Present Simple turibdi, “will” esa natija qismida. Eslang: “he” bilan fe’lga s qo‘shiladi, shuning uchun “calls”. Agar xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, tashvishlanmang, bu xatoni juda ko‘pchilik qiladi.
scenes.say: If you hurry, you'll catch the train. If he calls, I'll tell you. I'll help you if you ask.
scenes.say_uz: Shoshilsangiz, poyezdga ulgurasiz. U qo‘ng‘iroq qilsa, sizga aytaman. So‘rasangiz, yordam beraman.

scenes.title: Gap tartibi va vergul
board: If clause first → comma
If I see her, I'll tell her.
If clause second → no comma
I'll tell her if I see her.

examples.t: If I see her, I'll tell her.
I'll tell her if I see her.

scenes.say_native: Shart qismini gapning boshiga ham, oxiriga ham qo‘yish mumkin, ma’no o‘zgarmaydi. Shart boshida kelsa, ikki qism orasiga vergul qo‘yamiz: “If I see her, I’ll tell her.” Shart oxirida kelsa, odatda vergul kerak emas: “I’ll tell her if I see her.” O‘zbekchada shart gap deyarli doim gap boshida turadi, ingliz tilida esa ikkala tartib teng ishlatiladi. Og‘zaki nutqda ko‘pincha natija birinchi, shart keyin aytiladi.
scenes.say: If I see her, I'll tell her. Or: I'll tell her if I see her. The meaning is the same. Use a comma after the if clause when it comes first.
scenes.say_uz: Uni ko‘rsam, aytaman. Yoki: uni ko‘rsam, aytaman. Ma’no bir xil. Shart qismi birinchi kelsa, undan keyin vergul qo‘ying.

scenes.title: If va when
board: if = bo‘lishi mumkin (not sure)
when = albatta bo‘ladi (sure)
When I get home, I'll call you.

examples.t: When I get home, I'll call you.
examples.uz: Uyga yetib borganimda, sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

examples.t: If I get home early, I'll call you.
examples.uz: Uyga barvaqt yetib borsam, sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

scenes.say_native: “If” va “when” ikkalasi ham o‘zbekchada “-sa” yoki “-ganda” bo‘lib tarjima qilinadi, shuning uchun ularni aralashtirish oson. Farqi shunda: “when” ishlatsangiz, voqea albatta bo‘lishini bilasiz, faqat vaqti muhim. “If” esa voqea bo‘lishi ham, bo‘lmasligi ham mumkinligini bildiradi. Uyga albatta borasiz, shuning uchun “When I get home”. Lekin barvaqt borasizmi, noaniq, shuning uchun “If I get home early”. Ikkalasidan keyin ham Present Simple turadi.
scenes.say: When I get home, I'll call you. I will get home for sure. If I get home early, I'll call you. Maybe I will, maybe I won't.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga yetganimda, sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Uyga albatta yetaman. Uyga barvaqt yetsam, sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Balki yetaman, balki yo‘q.

scenes.title: If yoki when?
board: ✗ If I'm 30 next year, I'll buy a flat.
✓ When I'm 30, I'll buy a flat.
✗ When it rains, we'll cancel it. (noaniq)
✓ If it rains, we'll cancel it.
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda ikki tomonlama xato bor. Yoshingiz haqida gapirsangiz, “if” noto‘g‘ri, chunki o‘ttiz yoshga albatta to‘lasiz, to‘g‘risi — “When I’m thirty”. Aksincha, ertangi yomg‘ir noaniq bo‘lsa, “when” noto‘g‘ri eshitiladi, go‘yo yomg‘ir albatta yog‘adigandek. Shunda “if” deng. Savol o‘zingizga: “Bu albatta bo‘ladimi?” Ha bo‘lsa — when, yo‘q yoki bilmasam — if.
scenes.say: When I'm thirty, I'll buy a flat. You will be thirty for sure. If it rains, we'll cancel the picnic. Rain is only possible.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ttiz yoshga to‘lganimda, kvartira sotib olaman. O‘ttiz yoshga albatta to‘lasiz. Yomg‘ir yog‘sa, pikni bekor qilamiz. Yomg‘ir faqat mumkin.

scenes.title: If yoki when?
board: 1) ___ I finish work today, I'll go home. (sure)
2) ___ I finish early, I'll go to the gym. (maybe)
3) ___ you see Tom, say hello. (maybe)
scenes.say_native: Bo‘sh joyga “if” yoki “when” qo‘ying. Qavslardagi izohga qarang: sure — albatta bo‘ladi, maybe — balki. Birinchi gapda ishni albatta tugatasiz. Ikkinchisida barvaqt tugatasizmi, noaniq. Uchinchisida Tomni uchratasizmi, noaniq. Qaror qiling va to‘liq gapni ayting.
scenes.say: Choose if or when. One: I finish work today, sure. Two: I finish early, maybe. Three: you see Tom, maybe.
scenes.say_uz: If yoki when ni tanlang. Bir: bugun ishni tugataman, albatta. Ikki: barvaqt tugataman, balki. Uch: Tomni ko‘rasiz, balki.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) When
2) If
3) If
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gap: “When I finish work today, I’ll go home”, chunki ishni tugatishingiz aniq. Ikkinchi gap: “If I finish early, I’ll go to the gym”, chunki barvaqt tugatish noaniq. Uchinchi gap: “If you see Tom, say hello”, chunki uchrashish ham, uchrashmaslik ham mumkin. Oxirgi gapda natija qismida buyruq shakli turibdi, bu ham mumkin. Bu haqda birozdan keyin gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: When I finish work today, I'll go home. If I finish early, I'll go to the gym. If you see Tom, say hello.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun ishni tugatganimda, uyga ketaman. Barvaqt tugatsam, sport zaliga boraman. Tomni ko‘rsangiz, salom ayting.

scenes.title: Unless: agar ... bo‘lmasa
board: unless = if ... not
Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
= If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.

examples.t: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
I won't go unless you come with me.
examples.uz: Siz men bilan bormasangiz, men bormayman.

scenes.say_native: “Unless” so‘zi “agar ... bo‘lmasa” degan ma’noni beradi, ya’ni “if ... not” bilan deyarli bir xil. “Unless you hurry” — “shoshilmasangiz”. “Unless” inkor ma’noni o‘zida olib yuradi, shuning uchun undan keyin fe’l darak shaklda turadi. O‘zbekchada “-masa” qo‘shimchasi inkorni beradi, inglizchada esa inkor “unless” so‘zining ichida. Odatda “unless” shart yagona istisno ekanini bildiradi: faqat shu holda natija o‘zgaradi.
scenes.say: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus. That means: if you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus. I won't go unless you come with me.
scenes.say_uz: Shoshilmasangiz, avtobusdan qolasiz. Ya’ni: shoshilmasangiz, avtobusdan qolasiz. Men bilan bormasangiz, men bormayman.

scenes.title: Unless va ikkinchi inkor
board: ✗ Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
✓ Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
✓ If you don't hurry, you'll be late.
scenes.say_native: “Unless” ning o‘zi inkor, shuning uchun uning ketidan yana “don’t” qo‘ysangiz, ikki marta inkor bo‘lib qoladi. “Unless you don’t hurry” deganingiz, go‘yo “shoshmasangiz ham” deganga o‘xshab, ma’noni buzadi. O‘zbekchada ikki inkor ko‘p uchraydi, shuning uchun bu xatoga yo‘l qo‘yish oson. To‘g‘risi: yo “Unless you hurry”, yo “If you don’t hurry”. Faqat bitta shakldan foydalaning.
scenes.say: Unless you hurry, you'll be late. Or, if you don't hurry, you'll be late. Never say: unless you don't hurry.
scenes.say_uz: Shoshilmasangiz, kech qolasiz. Yoki: shoshilmasangiz, kech qolasiz. Hech qachon “unless you don't hurry” demang.

scenes.title: Unless bilan qayta yozing
board: 1) If you don't study, you'll fail.
2) If she doesn't call, I won't wait.
3) We'll play outside if it doesn't rain.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni “unless” bilan qayta yozing. “Don’t” yoki “doesn’t” ni olib tashlang va fe’lni darak shaklda qoldiring. Birinchi gap o‘qish haqida, ikkinchi gap qo‘ng‘iroq haqida, uchinchisi yomg‘ir haqida. Uchinchi gapda “unless” oxirida turadi, shuning uchun vergulga ehtiyoj yo‘q.
scenes.say: Rewrite with unless. If you don't study, you'll fail. If she doesn't call, I won't wait. We'll play outside if it doesn't rain.
scenes.say_uz: Unless bilan qayta yozing. O‘qimasangiz, yiqilasiz. U qo‘ng‘iroq qilmasa, kutmayman. Yomg‘ir yog‘masa, tashqarida o‘ynaymiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Unless you study, you'll fail.
2) Unless she calls, I won't wait.
3) We'll play outside unless it rains.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Unless you study, you’ll fail.” Ikkinchi: “Unless she calls, I won’t wait.” Uchinchi: “We’ll play outside unless it rains.” E’tibor bering: “unless” dan keyin “study”, “calls”, “rains” darak shaklda, hech qanday “don’t” yo‘q. Uchinchi gapda ma’no xuddi shunday: yomg‘ir yog‘masa, tashqarida o‘ynaymiz, yog‘sa esa o‘ynamaymiz.
scenes.say: Unless you study, you'll fail. Unless she calls, I won't wait. We'll play outside unless it rains.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qimasangiz, yiqilasiz. U qo‘ng‘iroq qilmasa, kutmayman. Yomg‘ir yog‘masa, tashqarida o‘ynaymiz.

scenes.title: Shart qismidagi zamonlar
board: Present Simple: If she comes, ...
Present Continuous: If you're leaving, ...
Present Perfect: If you've finished, ...

examples.t: If you're going to the shop, can you buy some milk?
examples.uz: Do‘konga ketayotgan bo‘lsangiz, sut olib kela olasizmi?

examples.t: If you've finished, you can go home.

scenes.say_native: Shart qismida ko‘pincha Present Simple turadi, lekin boshqa hozirgi zamon shakllari ham mumkin. Present Continuous hozir davom etayotgan yoki hozir rejalangan harakat uchun: “If you’re going to the shop, buy some milk.” Present Perfect esa tugagan harakat uchun: “If you’ve finished, you can go.” Bu ikki shaklda ham “will” yo‘q, hammasi hozirgi zamonda. O‘zbekchada “ketayotgan bo‘lsangiz” va “tugatgan bo‘lsangiz” deymiz, ingliz tilida ham ma’no aynan shunday.
scenes.say: If you're going to the shop, can you buy some milk? If you've finished your homework, you can watch TV. If he isn't feeling well, he should stay at home.
scenes.say_uz: Do‘konga ketayotgan bo‘lsangiz, sut olib kela olasizmi? Uy vazifasini tugatgan bo‘lsangiz, televizor ko‘rishingiz mumkin. U o‘zini yaxshi his qilmasa, uyda qolishi kerak.

scenes.title: Natija qismida modal va buyruq
board: If + Present, can / may / might / should + V1
If + Present, imperative
If you see Tom, tell him.

examples.t: If you see Tom, tell him about the meeting.
examples.uz: Tomni ko‘rsangiz, unga yig‘ilish haqida ayting.

examples.t: If it's sunny, we might go to the beach.
examples.uz: Ob-havo ochiq bo‘lsa, balki dengiz bo‘yiga boramiz.

scenes.say_native: Natija qismida faqat “will” turishi shart emas. Ehtimolni kamaytirmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, “might” ishlating: “we might go to the beach” — balki boramiz. Ruxsat uchun “can”, maslahat uchun “should”: “If you feel ill, you should see a doctor.” Buyruq va iltimos uchun fe’lning o‘zini ishlating: “If you see Tom, tell him.” Bularning hammasida shart qismi o‘zgarmaydi, doim Present Simple yoki boshqa hozirgi shakl turadi.
scenes.say: If it's sunny, we might go to the beach. If you feel ill, you should see a doctor. If you need help, you can ask me. If you see Tom, tell him.
scenes.say_uz: Ob-havo ochiq bo‘lsa, balki dengiz bo‘yiga boramiz. O‘zingizni yomon his qilsangiz, shifokorga borishingiz kerak. Yordam kerak bo‘lsa, mendan so‘rashingiz mumkin. Tomni ko‘rsangiz, unga ayting.

scenes.title: Va’da berish
board: I promise + I'll ...
If you help me, I'll buy you lunch.
I won't tell anyone if you don't want me to.

examples.t: If you help me, I'll buy you lunch.
examples.uz: Menga yordam bersangiz, sizga tushlik olib beraman.

examples.t: I promise I'll call you if I hear anything.
examples.uz: Biror narsa eshitsam, qo‘ng‘iroq qilishga va’da beraman.

scenes.say_native: First conditional va’da berish uchun juda qulay. Shart qismida kerakli harakat, natija qismida esa va’dangiz turadi: “If you help me, I’ll buy you lunch.” Ishonchli eshitilishi uchun oldiga “I promise” qo‘shing. Inkor va’da uchun “I won’t” ishlatiladi: “I won’t tell anyone.” O‘zbekchada bunday gaplarni ko‘pincha “-sangiz, ... -man” bilan ifodalaymiz, ingliz tilida ham tuzilish xuddi shunday, faqat “will” kerak.
scenes.say: If you help me, I'll buy you lunch. I promise I'll call you if I hear anything. If you lend me your book, I won't lose it.
scenes.say_uz: Menga yordam bersangiz, sizga tushlik olib beraman. Biror narsa eshitsam, qo‘ng‘iroq qilishga va’da beraman. Kitobingizni bersangiz, uni yo‘qotmayman.

scenes.title: Ogohlantirish
board: If you ..., you'll ... (xavf)
If you touch it, you'll get burned.
Unless you ..., you'll ...

examples.t: If you touch that, you'll get burned.
Unless you leave now, you'll miss your flight.

scenes.say_native: Ogohlantirish ham first conditional bilan ifodalanadi. Shart qismida xavfli harakat, natija qismida uning oqibati: “If you touch that, you’ll get burned.” Yana bir kuchli shakl — “unless”: “Unless you leave now, you’ll miss your flight.” Bunday gaplar yo‘l belgilarida, e’lonlarda va do‘stlar orasida ko‘p uchraydi. Ogohlantirishni muloyimroq qilish uchun “might” ishlating: “you might miss it”.
scenes.say: If you touch that, you'll get burned. If you don't wear a coat, you'll catch a cold. Unless you leave now, you'll miss your flight.
scenes.say_uz: Unga tegsangiz, kuyib qolasiz. Palto kiymasangiz, shamollab qolasiz. Hozir chiqmasangiz, reysdan qolasiz.

scenes.title: Va’da yoki ogohlantirish
board: 1) Friend is late. Warn him: the film ...
2) Your sister helps you. Promise: ...
3) The road is icy. Warn: ...
scenes.say_native: Uch vaziyat. Birinchida do‘stingiz kech qolyapti, film boshlanadi, uni ogohlantiring. Ikkinchida singlingiz sizga yordam beryapti, unga biror narsa va’da qiling. Uchinchida yo‘l muzlagan, haydovchini ogohlantiring. Har biri uchun bitta “if” yoki “unless” gap tuzing.
scenes.say: Three situations. Your friend is late. Warn him about the film. Your sister helps you. Make her a promise. The road is icy. Warn the driver.
scenes.say_uz: Uch vaziyat. Do‘stingiz kech qolyapti. Uni film haqida ogohlantiring. Singlingiz sizga yordam beryapti. Unga va’da bering. Yo‘l muzlagan. Haydovchini ogohlantiring.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1) If you don't hurry, you'll miss the start.
2) If you help me, I'll cook your favourite dinner.
3) If you drive fast, you'll skid.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchi: “If you don’t hurry, you’ll miss the start of the film.” Ikkinchi: “If you help me, I’ll cook your favourite dinner.” Uchinchi: “If you drive fast, you’ll skid”, ya’ni mashina sirpanib ketadi. Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, asosiysi tuzilish: “if” plus Present Simple, vergul, keyin “will” plus fe’l. Agar shunday qilgan bo‘lsangiz, barakalla!
scenes.say: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the start of the film. If you help me, I'll cook your favourite dinner. If you drive fast, you'll skid.
scenes.say_uz: Shoshilmasangiz, filmning boshlanishidan qolasiz. Menga yordam bersangiz, sevimli kechki ovqatingizni pishiraman. Tez haydasangiz, mashina sirpanadi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: dam olish kuni rejasi
board: Ben: Are you still coming on Saturday?
Mia: If the trains are running, I'll be there by noon.
Ben: Unless it stops raining, we won't go to the market.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Mia o‘z do‘sti Benning shahriga shanba kuni kelmoqchi. Ular poyezdlar va ob-havo haqida gaplashadi. Dialogda if, unless va when so‘zlariga e’tibor bering. Ben va Mia kelishuvga erisha oladimi? Keyin uchta savolga javob beramiz: nima bo‘ladi, qachon bo‘ladi va nima bo‘lmaydi. Diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Ben: Are you still coming on Saturday? Mia: Yes, if the trains are running. They said there might be a strike. Ben: If there is a strike, I'll drive to the station and get you. Mia: Thanks! I'll text you when I arrive. Ben: Great. Unless it stops raining, we won't go to the market. We'll visit the museum instead.
scenes.say_uz: Ben: Shanba kuni hali ham kelasanmi? Mia: Ha, poyezdlar yursa. Ish tashlash bo‘lishi mumkin deyishdi. Ben: Ish tashlash bo‘lsa, stansiyaga mashinada borib, seni olaman. Mia: Rahmat! Yetib borganimda, sms yozaman. Ben: Zo‘r. Yomg‘ir to‘xtamasa, bozorga bormaymiz. Uning o‘rniga muzeyga boramiz.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What will Ben do if there is a strike?
2) When will Mia text Ben?
3) When won't they go to the market?
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab, uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: agar ish tashlash bo‘lsa, Ben nima qiladi? Ikkinchi: Mia Benga qachon sms yozadi? Uchinchi: ular qachon bozorga bormaydilar? Javoblaringizni to‘liq gap bilan ayting va “if”, “when” yoki “unless” ni ishlating.
scenes.say: Answer the questions. What will Ben do if there is a strike? When will Mia text Ben? When won't they go to the market?
scenes.say_uz: Savollarga javob bering. Ish tashlash bo‘lsa, Ben nima qiladi? Mia Benga qachon sms yozadi? Ular qachon bozorga bormaydi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1) He'll drive to the station.
2) When she arrives.
3) Unless it stops raining.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: agar ish tashlash bo‘lsa, Ben stansiyaga mashinada boradi va Miani oladi. Ikkinchi: Mia yetib kelganida Benga sms yozadi, bu yerda “when”, chunki u albatta yetib keladi. Uchinchi: yomg‘ir to‘xtamasa, ular bozorga bormaydilar. Dialogdagi “unless it stops raining” ni “if it doesn’t stop raining” deb aytsa ham bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: If there is a strike, Ben will drive to the station. Mia will text when she arrives. They won't go to the market unless it stops raining.
scenes.say_uz: Ish tashlash bo‘lsa, Ben stansiyaga mashinada boradi. Mia yetib kelganida sms yozadi. Yomg‘ir to‘xtamasa, ular bozorga bormaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: uydagi kelishuv
board: Sam: If you leave the dishes, I won't cook tonight.
Nina: I'll wash them as soon as I finish this email.
Sam: Fine, but if you forget, I'll order pizza.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Sam va Nina bir uyda yashaydi. Ular idish-tovoqni kim yuvishi haqida gaplashadi. Bu yerda ogohlantirish va va’da bor, ularni topishga harakat qiling. “As soon as” iborasi ham uchraydi, undan keyin ham Present Simple turishini kuzating.
scenes.say: Sam: If you leave the dishes again, I won't cook tonight. Nina: Don't worry. I'll wash them as soon as I finish this email. Sam: Okay. But if you forget, I'll order pizza and you'll pay. Nina: Deal. If I'm still busy at seven, remind me.
scenes.say_uz: Sam: Idishlarni yana qoldirsang, bugun kechqurun ovqat pishirmayman. Nina: Xavotir olma. Bu xatni tugatishim bilan yuvaman. Sam: Mayli. Lekin unutsang, pitsa buyurtma qilaman, pulini sen to‘laysan. Nina: Kelishdik. Soat yettigacha band bo‘lsam, eslatib qo‘y.

scenes.title: Savollar: kim nima dedi?
board: 1) What is Sam's warning?
2) When will Nina wash the dishes?
3) What will Nina do if she's still busy at seven?
scenes.say_native: Dialogni yodingizga keltirib, uchta savolga javob bering. Bu savollar ogohlantirish, vaqt va shart haqida. Birinchi: Samning ogohlantirishi nima? Ikkinchi: Nina idishlarni qachon yuvadi? Uchinchi: agar Nina soat yettida hali band bo‘lsa, nima qilishi kerak? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering va if yoki as soon as dan foydalaning.
scenes.say: Answer the questions. What is Sam's warning? When will Nina wash the dishes? What should Nina do if she's still busy at seven?
scenes.say_uz: Savollarga javob bering. Samning ogohlantirishi nima? Nina idishlarni qachon yuvadi? Nina soat yettida hali band bo‘lsa, nima qiladi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1) If she leaves the dishes, he won't cook.
2) As soon as she finishes the email.
3) Sam should remind her.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Nina idishlarni qoldirsa, Sam kechki ovqat pishirmaydi. Ikkinchi: Nina xatni tugatishi bilan idishlarni yuvadi. Uchinchi: Ninaning iltimosiga ko‘ra, soat yettida hali band bo‘lsa, Sam unga eslatadi. Eslab qoling, “as soon as” ham vaqt ergash gapi, shuning uchun uning ketidan “will” kelmaydi, “as soon as I finish” deyiladi.
scenes.say: If Nina leaves the dishes, Sam won't cook. She will wash them as soon as she finishes the email. If she's still busy at seven, Sam will remind her.
scenes.say_uz: Nina idishlarni qoldirsa, Sam ovqat pishirmaydi. U xatni tugatishi bilan idishlarni yuvadi. Soat yettida hali band bo‘lsa, Sam unga eslatadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: I'll, he'll va won't
board: I'll /aɪl/ · he'll /hiːl/ · we'll /wiːl/
won't /wəʊnt/ ≠ want /wɒnt/
If it rains, | we'll stay in.

examples.t: I'll tell you if I know.
She won't come unless you ask.

scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda uchta narsaga e’tibor bering. Birinchisi: nutqda “will” deyarli doim “’ll” ga aylanadi: “I’ll”, “he’ll”, “we’ll”. Ikkinchisi: “won’t” va “want” ni adashtirmang. “Won’t” cho‘ziq “ou” diftongi bilan aytiladi, “want” esa qisqa “o” bilan. Bu ikki so‘z o‘rtasidagi farq ma’noni butunlay o‘zgartiradi. Uchinchisi: ohang. Shart qismi odatda tekis yoki ko‘tarilib tugaydi, natija qismi esa pasayib tugaydi. Bu ikki qism orasida kichik pauza bor.
scenes.say: I'll tell you if I know. She won't come unless you ask. If it rains, we'll stay in. Listen: I won't go. I want to go.
scenes.say_uz: Bilsam, aytaman. Siz so‘ramasangiz, u kelmaydi. Yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz. Tinglang: men bormayman. Men bormoqchiman.

scenes.title: Talaffuzni mashq qiling
board: If it rains, | we'll stay in.
I won't go unless you come.
She'll call when she arrives.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni takrorlang. Bu mashqda ritm va ohang eng muhim. Shart qismida ovozingiz tekis yoki biroz ko‘tarilsin, pauza qiling, natija qismida ovoz pasaysin. “Will” ni qisqartiring: “we’ll”, “she’ll”. “Won’t” dagi “ou” cho‘zilib aytilsin. Ikki marta takrorlang va ritmni yaxshi his qiling.
scenes.say: If it rains, we'll stay in. I won't go unless you come. She'll call when she arrives.
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz. Siz kelmasangiz, men bormayman. U yetib borganida qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi.

scenes.title: Model talaffuz
board: pause after the if clause
'll is short, won't is long
falling tone at the end
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi bajardingiz. Esda tuting: shart qismidan keyin kichik pauza, natija qismi esa tinchgina pasayuvchi ohang bilan tugaydi. “We’ll” juda qisqa va yengil aytiladi, deyarli “wil” kabi. “Won’t” esa uzoqroq va aniq eshitilishi kerak, chunki inkor ma’no unga bog‘liq. Bu ritm sizning inglizchangizni tabiiy va ravon qiladi, ayniqsa tez gaplashganda.
scenes.say: If it rains, we'll stay in. I won't go unless you come. She'll call when she arrives.
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz. Siz kelmasangiz, men bormayman. U yetib borganida qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: shahringiz
board: 1) Zero: If ..., ... (fact about your city)
2) First: If ..., you'll ... (advice)
3) Unless ..., ... (warning)
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz gapirasiz. O‘z shahringiz yoki qishlog‘ingiz haqida uchta gap ayting. Birinchisi zero conditional: umumiy haqiqat, ikkala qismda Present Simple. Ikkinchisi first conditional: sayyohga maslahat yoki va’da. Uchinchisi “unless” bilan ogohlantirish. Gaplar to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi uchun “will” ni faqat natija qismida ishlating.
scenes.say: Now speak about your own city. Say one zero conditional, one first conditional with advice, and one warning with unless.
scenes.say_uz: Endi o‘z shahringiz haqida gapiring. Bitta zero conditional, maslahat bilan bitta first conditional va unless bilan bitta ogohlantirish ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: If it snows, the traffic gets slow.
If you come in May, you'll see tulips.
Unless you wear a hat, you'll get too hot.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. Birinchi gap zero conditional: “If it snows, the traffic gets slow” — qor yog‘sa, tirbandlik kuchayadi. Ikkinchisi first conditional: “If you come in May, you’ll see tulips” — may oyida kelsangiz, lolalarni ko‘rasiz. Uchinchisi ogohlantirish: “Unless you wear a hat, you’ll get too hot.” Sizning gaplaringiz albatta o‘z shahringizga mos bo‘ladi, tuzilishi esa bir xil.
scenes.say: If it snows, the traffic gets slow. If you come in May, you'll see tulips in the parks. Unless you wear a hat in July, you'll get too hot.
scenes.say_uz: Qor yog‘sa, tirbandlik kuchayadi. Mayda kelsangiz, bog‘larda lolalarni ko‘rasiz. Iyulda shlyapa kiymasangiz, juda qizib ketasiz.

scenes.title: Dars yakuni
board: Zero: If + Present, Present
First: If + Present, will + V1
if / when / unless
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Zero conditional faktlar va odatlar uchun: ikki Present Simple. First conditional bitta kelajak imkoniyat uchun: shart qismida Present Simple, natijada “will”. “If” — bo‘lishi mumkin, “when” — albatta bo‘ladi, “unless” — “if ... not”. Shart qismida hech qachon “will” yo‘q. Va’da va ogohlantirish uchun first conditional juda qulay. Bugun yaxshi ish qildingiz!
scenes.say: Today you learned zero and first conditionals, and the difference between if, when and unless. Remember: no will after if. Well done!
scenes.say_uz: Bugun siz zero va first conditional hamda if, when va unless orasidagi farqni o‘rgandingiz. Eslang: if dan keyin will yo‘q. Barakalla!

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: 8 real conditionals about your city
Use: if, when, unless
No 'will' after if!
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘z shahringiz haqida sakkizta real shart gap yozing. Kamida bitta zero conditional, bitta va’da yoki ogohlantirish, bitta “unless” va bitta “when” bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: shart qismida “will” yo‘q, vergul to‘g‘ri qo‘yilgan. Keyingi darsda gipotetik shart gaplarni o‘rganamiz, ya’ni haqiqatda bo‘lmagan holatlar haqida gapiramiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: write eight real conditional sentences about your city. Check that there is no will after if. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: shahringiz haqida sakkizta real shart gap yozing. If dan keyin will yo‘qligini tekshiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: O‘z shahringiz (yoki qishlog‘ingiz) haqida sakkizta real shart gap yozing: kamida bitta zero conditional, bitta first conditional bilan va’da yoki ogohlantirish, bitta unless va bitta when bilan gap bo‘lsin. Mezon: shart qismida will yo‘q, unless dan keyin don't yo‘q, vergul to‘g‘ri qo‘yilgan.

quiz.q: If you ___ the water, it boils.
quiz.why_uz: Zero conditional: ikkala qismda Present Simple.

quiz.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
quiz.why_uz: First conditional: if dan keyin Present Simple, will emas.

options: If I will see him, I'll tell him.
If I see him, I'll tell him.
If I saw him, I tell him.
If I see him, I will to tell him.
quiz.why_uz: Shart qismida Present Simple, natijada will + fe’l.

quiz.q: I'll call you ___ I get home. (I will get home for sure.)
quiz.why_uz: Albatta bo‘ladigan voqea uchun when ishlatiladi.
Unless o‘zi inkor, undan keyin darak shakl turadi.

quiz.q: Which means the same as 'Unless she calls, I won't wait'?
options: If she calls, I won't wait.
If she doesn't call, I won't wait.
When she calls, I won't wait.
If she called, I wouldn't wait.

quiz.q: If you ___ finished, you can go home.
quiz.why_uz: Shart qismida Present Perfect: have finished.

options: If I see her I'll tell her.
If I see her, I'll tell her.
I'll tell her, if I see her.
If, I see her I'll tell her.
quiz.why_uz: Shart qismi birinchi kelsa, undan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi.

quiz.q: Choose the best warning: 'If you touch that, ___.'

options: If ice melts, it becomes water.
If it melts, we'll be wet tomorrow.
If it melted, we'd be wet.
If it will melt, we are wet.
quiz.why_uz: Doim to‘g‘ri fakt uchun zero conditional ishlatiladi.
